About this site

Sources & site information

Information about research sources and the handling of inquiry details.

Research information

Education, appointments, recognition and the bibliography are based on the CV supplied by Dong Hun Lee and appointment updates confirmed on 11 October 2026. The 215 entries correspond to its main publication section, with final publication details updated where verified; separately listed case reports and conference abstracts are not included in that number. Research summaries stay within the scope of the cited publications.

This site introduces research and invites inquiries about research participation. Human studies and animal-model findings should be distinguished when interpreting the work.

Medical-device, EBD and collaboration descriptions draw on the lab introduction supplied by the PI, related publications and the IHEIB research areas. Funding supporters are listed as provided by the PI.

Inquiry form & privacy

The inquiry form opens a draft in your email application. Its contents are not submitted to, stored by or analyzed on this site’s server. If you send the email, it is delivered through the recipient’s email system. No tracking or analytics scripts are used. Web fonts are loaded from Google Fonts, which may receive a request from your browser.

Visual materials

The homepage slideshow uses research images excerpted from publications by the principal investigator. Each image identifies its figure panel and links to the publication, with the source copyright or license information. Click an image to view the full-size excerpt in its original proportions. Research-theme vector artwork and the AI-generated social preview image are conceptual illustrations, not experimental data.
